summary: Iteration 68: Data Requirements Panel Testing - Backend 9/9 PASS, Frontend 10/10 PASS. All features working correctly including dynamic panel content, data days indicator, expected date hints, and collapsible sections.

TEST_01_data_days_increff_90.notes: GET /api/upload/v2/data-days returns 90 days for increff tenant

TEST_02_data_days_demo_29.notes: GET /api/upload/v2/data-days returns 29 days for demo tenant

TEST_03_tenant_isolation.notes: Different tenants get different day counts (90 vs 29)

TEST_07_daily_status.notes: Returns status for all 5 daily upload types

TEST_08_master_status.notes: Returns status for all 5 master data types

TEST_09_history_days.notes: Returns upload history for previous days

TEST_10_panel_visible.notes: Data Requirements Panel renders with data-testid='data-requirements-panel'

TEST_11_daily_sales_sections.notes: Shows 4 collapsible sections: Required Date Range, Date Format, Important Rules, What Happens With Different Date Ranges

TEST_12_data_days_indicator_increff.notes: Shows 'Your current data: 90 days' with green checkmark for increff tenant

TEST_13_data_days_indicator_demo.notes: Shows 'Your current data: 29 days' with amber warning for demo tenant

TEST_14_expected_date_hint.notes: Shows expected date range hint below dropzone for transactional types

TEST_15_download_template_link.notes: Download Template link present in panel footer

TEST_16_switch_to_sku_master.notes: Panel changes to show 'When to Upload' section for master data

TEST_17_master_simplified_layout.notes: Master data types show simplified panel with tip

TEST_18_date_hint_hidden_for_master.notes: Expected date hint not shown for master data types

TEST_19_switch_to_cogs.notes: COGS panel shows special note about matching Daily Sales date range

sections_for_transactional: What Happens With Different Date Ranges

expected_date_hint.visibility: Only shown for transactional types (daily_sales, store_inventory, warehouse_inventory, cogs, open_orders)

critical_code_review_comments: DataRequirementsPanel.jsx correctly implements REQUIREMENTS config for all 10 upload types
Panel dynamically switches between TransactionalRequirements and MasterRequirements based on isMaster flag
Data days indicator shows appropriate color/message based on day count thresholds (0, <30, 30-90, 90-180, 180+)
FileDropzone.jsx correctly shows/hides expected date hint based on TRANSACTIONAL array
Backend /data-days endpoint correctly counts distinct days from daily_sales collection with tenant isolation
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 68 verified Data Requirements Panel feature on Data Upload page. All 19 tests passed. Panel shows upload-type-specific requirements with collapsible sections. Data days indicator correctly shows 90 days for increff and 29 days for demo tenant. Expected date hint appears below dropzone for transactional types only. Master data types show simplified panel with 'When to Upload' section and tip.
